turns.replyText:
At Tediber, we want you to be fully satisfied with your products. Here is how our return policy works:

Trial Periods:

You benefit from a 100-night trial for mattresses, bed bases, beds, and sofas. This starts from the day of delivery.
For bed linen and mattress protectors, you have a 30-day trial period.
You also have a legal right of withdrawal of 14 calendar days from the receipt of your order.

How to initiate a return:

Contact us: Send an email to hello@tediber.com or use our online return form.
Appointment or Label: For large items, a carrier will contact you to schedule a pickup at your home. For smaller items, we will send you a prepaid Chronopost return label by email.
Pickup: Large items are collected for free at your home. Small items should be dropped off at a post office or a pickup point.
Refund: Once the item is received at our warehouse, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 15 business days (usually within 72 hours for large items).

All returns are completely free!

Feel free to contact us anytime; we're here to help.

The return period depends on the product you have purchased:

100 days: This trial period applies to mattresses, bed bases, beds, and sofas.
30 days: This period applies to bed linen and mattress protectors.
14 days: This is the legal withdrawal period available for all orders.

Please note that these periods begin on the date your order is delivered. 🙂
